messages:
maria: Quick sync 1 need a clean cutline decision today so engineering can freeze scope by EOD. We have three contested items: SSA full auth, tenant-usage export, and real-time dashboards. Proposal: MVP = chat core + embeddings + SSO skeleton behind flag. Defer dashboards & full exports to v1.

devon: +1. Full SSA remains a compliance/infra project 1 not safe for the MVP runway. Will mark effort medium+ and owner it.

anya: OK with SSO skeleton + flag. I'll draft gating rules (pilot whitelist, telemetry, rollback). That keeps sales moving without landing SSA.

sam: If dashboards are deferred we should hide nav entries and surface an empty-state with a "roadmap" CTA. I can ship the microcopy + placeholder by EOD.

rafael: Recommend pinning to 13B quantized for MVP to stabilize p99. If we defer dashboards, disable expensive nightly evals in CI. Also will run perf numbers and post by 16:00.

maria: Launch criteria we must meet: p99 chat < 700ms, telemetry for errors/latency/token usage, canary with 3 pilot tenants, documented rollback, zero P0 security blockers.

devon: I'll build a deps/risk matrix with S/M/L estimates and infra/security flags. Posting in #docs by 17:00.

anya: I'll own the feature-flag plan + pilot onboarding checklist.

sam: Nav + empty-state microcopy ready by EOD; will include screenshots.

rafael: Perf run posted: p50=110ms, p95=320ms, p99=610ms on 13B quantized baseline. Adding notes about quality delta vs 30B float.

ops-bot: Reminder: "MVP cut checkpoint" tomorrow 10:00 in #all-hands.

maria: Action list: devon (deps/risk), anya (flag+pilot), sam (UI copy), rafael (perf). We'll lock final cut at the checkpoint. If anyone objects to deferring dashboards now, speak up.

devon: Question: do we need a minimal set of metrics beyond requests/errors/latency/token cost? If not, I'll keep metrics minimal.

maria: Minimal only. Detailed analytics pushed to v1.

anya: Sales wants a rough ETA for tenant export. I'll create a one-pager with expected v1 window so we don't overpromise.

rafael: I'll add perf caveats for later quantization swaps into the decision doc.

maria: Consensus seems clear. We'll capture decisions in the milestone ticket and use it to trigger any timeline resets. Thanks team.

sam: no objections 1 cleaner MVP is better.

anya: no objections.

rafael: fine by me.
